categories_thin: Psychotherapists / counselors: Edison has many solo LPC/LCSW practices that advertise only on Psychology Today and are effectively individual practitioners; only the ones with their own websites or a clinic name are listed here, so this category is undercounted.
Nail salons and hair salons: many small storefront salons appear only in Booksy/Google and were partially captured; expect more.
Home-health, hospice and visiting-nurse agencies were not systematically searched for group B.
caveats: Several businesses are recorded from a single bulk directory (noted as 'one directory only') and need triage confirmation before outreach.

Some entries are individual practitioners rather than multi-staff businesses (e.g. solo dentists, solo therapists); included because they are independent local businesses, but they may be too small to be good prospects.

Excluded as national/regional chains or franchises: Banfield Pet Hospital, Aspen Dental, Diamond Braces, Dr. Dental, LaserAway, Evolve Med Spa, LA Fitness, Planet Fitness, Retro Fitness, Orangetheory, F45 Training, JAG Physical Therapy, Twin Boro Physical Therapy, Professional Physical Therapy.
Addresses for several practices (mostly optometry, med spas and counseling) were not visible on the page copy captured; recorded as Unknown rather than guessed.
data_gaps: Overpass API / OpenStreetMap was not used for this pass.
Google Maps and Bing Maps were not opened in a browser; map-level completeness (especially small salons and studios) is therefore unverified.
NJ Division of Consumer Affairs license lookup (dentists, chiropractors, etc.) was not queried, so licenses/active status are unconfirmed.
Yelp, Yellow Pages and BBB pages were not opened (blocked or not attempted); several categories rely on secondary aggregators.
